nodes.text: Create an ornate classical garden complex spread across irregular islands in calm blue water. Organize pale stone walkways, lawns, courtyards, canals, ponds, terraces, and low arcades into a dense rectilinear core that opens into curved peripheral gardens. Use peach and cream stucco, pink trim, columns, arches, balustrades, and vine-covered pergolas. Thread turquoise waterways beneath bridges and colonnades, with short spillways between levels. Edge the land with promenades and curving retaining walls. Add detached circular pavilion islands with concentric grassy terraces and domed gazebos. Fill gardens with hedges, flowers, topiary, varied trees, and urn planters under a soft pink-blue sky and hazy mountainous horizon.
